vulnerabilities.explanation: The code attempts to access elements by their IDs using `document.getElementById`. If any of these elements (`voting-card` or `voter-greeting`) do not exist in the DOM when `openVotingPanel` is called, `document.getElementById` will return `null`. Subsequently, attempting to call methods like `.classList.remove()`, `.textContent =`, or `.scrollIntoView()` on a `null` object will result in a runtime error (TypeError: Cannot read properties of null). This is a common issue in frontend applications where DOM elements might not be immediately available or might be conditionally rendered.
